review: The decision, subject, and August 15 date are retained. Medium and low omit the explicit recovery-retention instruction; none retains it in a separate atom but without Larch and with capture time.

All profiles retain the aggregate review, retry, recovery, and unappointed-owner facts, but several independent atoms omit Larch and use capture or referenced-event time. Low additionally dates the keep-delivery instruction to October 20 instead of the August 22 event.

All profiles preserve the audit prerequisite, POLL-71 before approval, STREAM-93 after approval, staging boundary, Mira, and lack of production authority. Capture time is still used as a precise effective time.
